purpose: Define modality terms that future claim candidates must use.

modalities.use_rule: Use when the cube observed a carrier/row/label/URL/payload envelope; no content claim.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use when a source says something, without adopting it as corpus fact.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for allegations in complaints, news, oversight complaints, or source materials.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for source-attributed denials or contested facts.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for filed charges; not guilt or finding.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for complaints, motions, memoranda, notices.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use only for verified orders or equivalent adjudicatory texts.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use only when a competent body found or sustained a bounded issue.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use only when source states insufficient evidence or equivalent category.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use only when source states officer acted lawfully/within policy or equivalent.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.public_label: incident not found to have occurred
modalities.use_rule: Use only when source states unfounded/no occurrence category.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for settlements where settlement status is known and admission is not established.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.public_label: settled with admitted fact or stipulated finding
modalities.use_rule: Use only with exact admission/stipulation language.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for procedural dismissal; never merits unless order says so.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for criminal conviction or plea with source and status caveats.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for acquittal; distinct from exoneration by department.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for appellate or subsequent action undoing earlier state.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for source availability state, not absence of event.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use when newer source changes or replaces earlier record.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.

modalities.use_rule: Use for missingness; never infer absence.
modalities.default_display_caveat: Display only with source, date, scope, and review state; blocked in rev0018.
